sentences.text: 2. The 2nd respondent registered Ext.P1 crime 2025:KER:40055 alleging offences punishable under Sections 406, 120B, 468 & 420 r/w 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 against 13 persons based on Ext.P2 complaint of the defacto complainant.
3. The crux of the allegation is that the accused with an intention to deceive the defacto complainant and others for obtaining wrongful gain hatched a criminal conspiracy.
The 1 st accused was the board member of Mulanthuruthy Service Co- operative Bank.
The 2nd accused is the wife of the 1 st accused.
The 3rd accused was the then Secretary of the bank.
The 4 th and other accused were the then board members of the said bank.
It is alleged that serious forgery and cheating is committed by the accused.
According to the petitioners, the investigation is not conducted properly.
It is submitted that the petitioners are also aggrieved party.
The prayer in this Writ Petition is for a direction to appoint the jurisdictional Deputy Superintendent of Police to supervise the investigation.
4. The Public Prosecutor submitted that the investigation is going on.
Accused Nos.11, 12, and 13 passed away, and the investigation, as far as the other accused are 2025:KER:40055 concerned, is going on.

5. If that be the case, since it is a forgery and cheating by the office bearers of a society, the jurisdictional Deputy Superintendent of Police should supervise the investigation conducted by the present Investigating Officer.

Therefore, this Writ Petition (Crl.) is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The jurisdictional Deputy Superintendent of Police will supervise the investigation conducted by the Investigating Officer in Crime No.1129/2024 of Mulanthuruthy Police Station.
2.
The petitioner will produce a certified copy of this judgment to the competent officer for follow up action.
